description: note isn't a brand or a business. it's a practice and a lens: a way of noticing and finding meaning in everyday life and everyday space. it lives, for now, on instagram. some posts are theory, shot to camera; some are designed carousels; some are just personal, unfiltered pieces about noticing something and sitting with it.
honestNote: this is a working practice, not a finished archive. most of what's here is still taking shape: some posts are live, some are drafted, some are scripts waiting to be filmed. that's the honest state of it.
